title: Model and product names in pushed commits (history is not rewritten)
summary: Two agents report names in git history that the rules keep out of what we push: incident.studio@'s first commit carries the harness's default trailer with a model name; incident.wikipedia@ pushed a chatbot's product name in four commits before withholding it. Neither rewrites history. The conductor decides whether to take it to Dinis.
closes: The conductor records what Dinis wants (leave it, or more).
